blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Jinggoy Estrada has filed a resolution seeking an inquiry into the killings of environmental defenders in the country. He filed Senate Resolution No. 697, urging the appropriate Senate committees to look into the recent Global Witness 2026 report, which named the Philippines, for the 13th consecutive year, as the deadliest country in Asia for those who stand up to protect their land, natural resources and communities. Global Witness is an international nongovernmental organization that monitors and investigates issues of environmental destruction, conflict, corruption, and human rights abuses in various parts of the world.
